title: Mika hình thái 1 · đánh thường (sheet attack)

back.note: kéo kiếm ra sau vai (đã duyệt)

cut.note: nhát chém trúng chéo xuống phía trước (đã duyệt)

mid.note: chém ngang ra trước (đã duyệt), mốc giữa đường chém

style: Static locked camera, three-quarter view facing screen-right, matching the reference, the whole body always inside the frame with a margin, her face visible, the flat solid magenta background never changes. Clean anime game sprite animation, crisp lines. Her braid, loose hair, scarf ends, ribbons and fox tail always keep moving with natural delay and follow-through, never frozen.

segments.name: P
segments.prompt: A chibi fox-girl samurai in red and gold armour. With the katana already unsheathed and held in both hands, she smoothly brings it into the exact drawn-back pose of the final reference, coiling the torso slightly. No pause at the endpoint. Feet remain planted at the reference positions; no stepping, turning or scale change. Preserve her identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid katana. Wind or motion affects only hair, cloth and tail; no added flames, aura or particles.

segments.name: Q
segments.prompt: A chibi fox-girl samurai in red and gold armour. From the drawn-back pose she performs one decisive diagonal downward slash toward screen-right, accelerating sharply through the strike and decelerating into the exact final cut pose. She shifts her weight without taking a step. Both hands stay on the same rigid katana; no extra slash or rebound. Preserve her identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid katana. Wind or motion affects only hair, cloth and tail; no added flames, aura or particles.

segments.name: R
segments.prompt: A chibi fox-girl samurai in red and gold armour. She continues the existing momentum with a small follow-through, then smoothly returns to the exact guard pose of the final reference. No second attack, flourish or pause before recovery. Feet remain planted at the reference positions; no stepping, turning or scale change. Preserve her identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid katana. Wind or motion affects only hair, cloth and tail; no added flames, aura or particles.

segments.name: Q2
segments.prompt: A chibi fox-girl samurai in red and gold armour. From the drawn-back pose she instantly slashes down: one short, explosive diagonal cut toward screen-right, the katana travelling straight from behind her shoulder to the low forward cut of the last frame without circling her head. She shifts her weight without stepping. Preserve her identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid katana. Motion affects only hair, cloth and tail; no added flames, aura or particles.
segments.why: Codex frames 6.5: Q lượn kiếm quanh đầu, chém thiếu dứt khoát

segments.name: R2
segments.prompt: A chibi fox-girl samurai in red and gold armour. After a low forward cut, the blade keeps travelling down a little further in a short follow-through, then she smoothly lifts the katana back into her calm guard stance. No second attack, no bounce, feet planted. Preserve her identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid katana. Motion affects only hair, cloth and tail; no added flames, aura or particles.
segments.why: Codex: hướng kiếm bật ngược ở nối Q->R

segments.name: Q3
segments.prompt: A chibi fox-girl samurai in red and gold armour. From the drawn-back pose she swings the katana around and forward into the level forward slash of the last frame, fast, the blade sharp and fully visible in every frame. Feet planted. Preserve her identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid katana, always drawn at full length and clearly visible. Motion affects only hair, cloth and tail; no added flames, aura or particles.

segments.name: Q4
segments.prompt: A chibi fox-girl samurai in red and gold armour. From a level forward slash she drives the katana on down into the low forward cut of the last frame, fast, the blade sharp and fully visible in every frame. Weight shifts forward, no step. Preserve her identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid katana, always drawn at full length and clearly visible. Motion affects only hair, cloth and tail; no added flames, aura or particles.

game.code: src/combat-v3.js attack(): lunge ~0.76s, poses by role (0 guard, 1 drawn back, 2 swing starts, 3 contact ~427ms, 4 follow-through, 5 recover); 3 stance variants when chaining (sweep, rising, overhead)
game.plan: 24 khung: 0-6 thủ -> kéo kiếm ra sau (P), 7-14 chém (Q, nhanh), 15-23 theo đà -> thủ (R, khung cuối = rest); roles ánh xạ 6 tư thế cũ sang khung clip, runtime đi qua mọi khung giữa
game.scope: một clip = một đường chém chéo xuống (biến thể sweep); các biến thể rising/overhead khi nối đòn vẫn lấy tư thế theo role (runtime nhảy lùi khung)

review: Codex spec 7/10 -> prompt P/Q/R theo đề xuất
pick_note: soát 12/11: Q3 khung 5 (nhòe chuyển động) bị Codex vẽ thành hai thanh kiếm -> bỏ, về bộ chọn trước (Q3 1-4 -> mốc chém ngang)
why_q: Codex frames2 7.5: lưỡi kiếm nhòe mất ở giữa nhát chém -> chém qua mốc chém ngang đã duyệt
